svg.title: Vaporia — Scald and Steam. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Boil classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Rising Steam forks into Geyser Fist then Caldera Burst, or Blistering Mist then Boiling Point. Vapor Shroud forks into Siphoned Heat then Dew of the Dragon, or Scalding Backlash then Wall of Steam. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Boil jutsu.

Rising Steam answers \"How do I make the rush hit harder: scald everyone around me or brand one target?\": Caldera Burst sets up Drowning Strike's spiral exposure and pays off with a controlled +2 Damage on all three attacks (no tier crossing), Boiling Point brands the Shell's target with +10% Afterburn. Vapor Shroud answers \"How do I outlast the exchange: heal through my own hits or punish theirs?\": Dew of the Dragon reaches the +5% Lifesteal ceiling with a palm Heal rider, Wall of Steam returns 50% of incoming hits behind 35% Decrease Damage Taken. 47), Increase Damage Given +2%, Increase Damage Taken +5%, Decrease Damage Taken +5%, Afterburn +10%, Lifesteal +5%, Reflect +10%, Heal +5%. No capstone shares a tag with its sibling Hidden Art.","Delivery at the pin: SELF rows land on the caster once per cast (actions.ts 980\u20131004, 1062\u20131066), so Surfing Strike's Decrease Damage Taken, Scorch Break's Reflect and the Shell's Lifesteal and Increase Damage Given are plain 2-round self buffs. Drowning Strike's rows are INHERIT rows on a GROUND spiral of radius 4 around the caster (own tile excluded); its 2-round exposure is a ground effect re-applied each round to whoever stands on a tile.","Interactions: the Shell's three rows and Drowning Strike's exposure are Taijutsu-filtered but element-less, so they match every element-less hit of any stat type plus Taijutsu elemental hits, the three Boil attacks included; Afterburn reads the hit after Increase Damage Given and Increase Damage Taken. Damage modifiers and Afterburn skip pierce; Lifesteal and Reflect include it. The bloodline Increase Damage Given passive multiplies last.","Uptime: every jutsu has cooldown 7. The Shell is 40 AP, single target, and needs a legal OTHER_USER target for its self rows; the Boil attacks and Azure Dragon Palm cost 60 AP. Buff, exposure and Afterburn windows are the 2 rounds after the cast.","Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) + Blistering Mist or Vapor Shroud; Burn (01,04,05) + Geyser Fist or Vapor Shroud; Sustain (06,07,08) + Rising Steam or Scalding Backlash; Retaliation (06,09,10) + Siphoned Heat or Rising Steam. The strongest are the offensive siblings: on a Shell-branded target standing in the spiral, during the Shell buff, Burst + Blistering Mist gives \u00d71.37 \u00d7 1.40 \u00d7 1.38 \u2248 \u00d72.65 plus +2 EP on the attacks and Burn + Geyser Fist \u00d71.37 \u00d7 1.40 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d72.78 on every matching hit, against the kit's own \u00d71.35 \u00d7 1.35 \u00d7 1.35 \u2248 \u00d72.46; both give up all mitigation. Retaliation + Rising Steam is the highest row-weighted build only because Rising Steam touches two glue rows; it stacks no tag with the capstone."],"risks":["Classification: Boil is the single signature element on the three Damage rows and no other captured bloodline has Boil jutsu; ordinary Boil jutsu are in scope by rule and unverified. 3 of 10 supported kit rows carry Boil; the other seven need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Liquid Ember Shell (no Boil row) qualifies in-kit only through an authored Boil jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1).","Ally hazard (validator warns): Drowning Strike's Increase Damage Taken is an INHERIT ground row with friendly fire none (=ALL); allies on a spiral tile, and the caster if it steps onto one, take the exposure too. Rising Steam (+2%) and Geyser Fist (+3%) raise it to 37% / 40%; the Damage row (friendly fire ENEMIES) is unaffected. Positioning decides.","Afterburn: Boiling Point makes the Shell's Afterburn 45% on one target for 2 rounds; a second Afterburn source saturates the 60% per-hit cap and wastes part of the +10%. Casting the Shell on an ally for its self rows afterburns that ally. Not simulated.","Lifesteal: Dew of the Dragon's 45% reads every hit the caster lands in the Shell window, pierce included, within the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage leech budget shared with vamp; +5% is the hard ceiling.","Reflect: Wall of Steam returns 50% of each hit taken during Scorch Break's window, pierce included and bypassing shields; realized value depends on incoming damage. Not simulated.","Damage: Caldera Burst's +2 is formula power on three area attacks, multiplied by the exposure, the Shell's buff and the bloodline passive; realized value scales with target count, which was not modelled.","Heal: Azure Dragon Palm's static 25 is two ticks of 250 HP; Dew's +5% makes them 300 HP, +100 HP per 7-round cycle, a rider rather than a route.","Unsupported rows and scope: Surfing Strike's move and Azure Dragon Palm's pierce receive nothing; no hidden, item-gated, mode-restricted, injected or adverse rows; the Water Decrease Damage Taken passive is not a potency target. Skill-tree effects are skipped in ranked modes. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Boil jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Dew of the Dragon path + Rising Steam
Wall of Steam path + Siphoned Heat
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · LS: Lifesteal · REF: Reflect · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE VAPORIA KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Liquid Ember Shell · Increase Damage Given
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Boil classification / forked tree
